prompt_md: A clock chimes once at 1 o'clock, twice at 2, and so on up to 12 times at 12, day and night. How many times does it chime in one full day?
prompt_short: Chimes the hour, 1 to 12, day and night. Chimes per day?
hint_md: How many times does the hour hand go around in a day?
explain_intuition_md: One trip around the dial is 1 + 2 + ... + 12 = 78 chimes. But the hour hand goes around twice a day, so the clock does it all twice.
